title: Formatting that disappears
objective: Find a non-empty string that NFC keeps unchanged but NFKC changes.

inputs.label: Text
inputs.description: Look for circled, wide, or superscript forms.

graphDescription: NFC preserves compatibility distinctions that NFKC intentionally removes.
hints: Compatibility characters encode a presentation or semantic distinction.
The explorer lists compatibility relatives separately from canonical relatives.
Try ①, fullwidth ａ, or superscript ¹.
explanation: NFC only resolves canonical equivalence. NFKC additionally removes compatibility distinctions, so symbols such as circled digits can normalize to ordinary text.
